2026_010_march_2026_p_card_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card listing for March 2026 itemizes every P-Card charge posted to district accounts, giving the transaction date, the merchant description as it arrived from the card processor, the journal-entry tag "MAR 26 PCARD", a business-unit string, an object account code and the amount. Page footers number the listing through 46 and all carry the print date 5/7/2026; it was carried in the Board of Education materials for the meeting of May 19, 2026. The listing closes with a printed total of $338,936.01, and its largest single line is an $8,500.00 charge dated 02/26/26 to THE WESTIN BOOK CADILL coded 101070127521000 / 3220.

Every row carries the identical journal-entry description "MAR 26 PCARD," so the differentiating fields are the merchant string passed through from the card processor, the business-unit code (for example 101051112005100, 700070399715500, 122885221326000, 529202229660000, 531004118620000 or 423071113315600) and a trailing object code such as 5110, 5990, 5910, 5000, 3220, 3210, 3190, 3450, 4110, 4120, 6410, 7410, 7910 or 7919.
